# SubStrUsedAsArrayAccess

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Performance](/rules/#performance) · PhpStorm name: `SubStrUsedAsArrayAccessInspection`

Extracting a single character with `substr($str, $i, 1)` costs a function call;
string offset access (`$str[$i]`) reads the same byte directly. Negative
positions are translated to `strlen($str) - n`.

## Example

At PHP 7.0+:

::: code-group

```php{8,9,10} [Before]
<?php
class Token {
    /** @var string */
    public $raw = '';
}
function peek(string $buf, int $at, int $back, string $key, Token $t, $any)
{
    $a = substr($buf, $at, 1);
    $b = \substr($buf, -1, 1);
    $c = substr($t->raw, 0, 1);

    $d = mb_substr($buf, $at, 1);
    $e = substr($buf, $at, 2);
    $f = substr(strrev($buf), 0, 1);
    $g = substr($at, 0, 1);
    $h = substr($any, 0, 1);
    $i = substr($buf, -3, 1);
    $j = substr($buf, -$back, 1);
    $k = substr($buf, $key, 1);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i, $j, $k];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
class Token {
    /** @var string */
    public $raw = '';
}
function peek(string $buf, int $at, int $back, string $key, Token $t, $any)
{
    $a = ($buf[$at] ?? '');
    $b = ($buf[strlen($buf) - 1] ?? '');
    $c = ($t->raw[0] ?? '');

    $d = mb_substr($buf, $at, 1);
    $e = substr($buf, $at, 2);
    $f = substr(strrev($buf), 0, 1);
    $g = substr($at, 0, 1);
    $h = substr($any, 0, 1);
    $i = substr($buf, -3, 1);
    $j = substr($buf, -$back, 1);
    $k = substr($buf, $key, 1);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f, $g, $h, $i, $j, $k];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 8: Use &#39;($buf[$at] ?? &#39;&#39;)&#39; (string offset access) instead.</li>
<li>line 9: Use &#39;($buf[strlen($buf) - 1] ?? &#39;&#39;)&#39; (string offset access) instead.</li>
<li>line 10: Use &#39;($t-&gt;raw[0] ?? &#39;&#39;)&#39; (string offset access) instead.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SubStrUsedAsArrayAccess": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SubStrUsedAsArrayAccess

/**
 * @noinspection SubStrUsedAsArrayAccessInspection
 */
```
